title: nicotiana excelsior
intro: Nicotiana excelsior, commonly known as Datura or Angel's Trumpet, is a plant species in the nightshade family, known for its large, showy flowers and potential medicinal properties. The health benefits of Nicotiana excelsior include its use in traditional medicine to treat anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation due to its sedative and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to induce relaxation, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote better sleep. The bioactive constituents of Nicotiana excelsior include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
